adjudication.rationale: The diff changes embed host checks from an in-memory SiteSetting list to `EmbeddableHost.host_allowed?`, which executes `where("lower(host) = ?", host).first` in `record_for_host`. This is called from `EmbedController#ensure_embeddable` and `TopicRetriever#invalid_host?`, so it will perform a DB query on each such check. The migration creating `embeddable_hosts` adds no index on `host`, and because the predicate wraps the column in `lower(host)`, even a plain index on `host` would typically not be used without a functional index (or normalized lowercased storage). This is a concrete performance defect introduced by the diff.
